title: A Computational Investigation on Chitosan Derivatives using Pharmacophore- based Screening, Molecular Docking, and Molecular Dynamics Simulations against Kaposi Sarcoma.
authors: Sakthivel, Kiruba; Ganapathy, Priyanka; Chandrasekaran, Kirubhanand; Subbaraj, Gowtham Kumar; Kulanthaivel, Langeswaran
one_liner_zh: 该文用药效团筛选、分子对接和MD研究壳聚糖衍生物对SOX蛋白（DNA结合蛋白）的抑制，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合蛋白，但核心是药物小分子抑制肿瘤，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cancer is one of the most dangerous illnesses to the human body due to its severity and progressive nature. Kaposi's Sarcoma (KS) tumor can appear as painless purple spots on the legs, foot, or face. This cancer develops in the lining of lymph arteries and blood vessels. Along with the enlargement of lymph nodes, the vaginal region and the mouth portion are the additional target areas of KS. DNA-binding proteins known as Sox proteins are found in all mammals and belong to the HMG box superfamily. They controlled a wide range of developmental procedures, such as the formation of the germ layer, the growth of organs, and the selection of the cell type. Human developmental abnormalities and congenital illnesses are frequently caused by the deletion or mutation of the Sox protein. AIM: The purpose of this study is to determine the promising Kaposi's sarcoma inhibitors through computational studies. OBJECTIVE: In this present study computational approaches were used to evaluate the anti- carcinogenic efficacy against Kaposi's sarcoma. METHODS: Ligand-based pharmacophore screening was performed utilising four different chemical libraries (Asinex, Chembridge, Specs, and NCI Natural products (NSC)) depending on the top hypothesis. The top hits were examined using molecular docking, absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion. Highest occupied molecular orbital and lowest unoccupied molecular orbital were analysed to determine the lead compounds' biological and pharmacological efficacy. The results of the study indicated that the leading candidates were possible SOX protein inhibitors. RESULTS: A pharmacophore model to inhibit the production of SOX protein in Kaposi Sarcoma was generated in this computational experiment using a set of 19 Chitosan compounds. CONCLUSION: The results revealed that the top hits responded to all of the pharmacological druglikening criteria and had the best interaction residues, fitness scores, and docking scores. The resulting leads might be potential Kaposi's Sarcoma alternative treatments.
abstract_zh: 背景：癌症因其严重性和进行性特征，是对人体最具危险的疾病之一。卡波西肉瘤（Kaposi's Sarcoma, KS）肿瘤可表现为腿部、足部或面部无痛性紫色斑点。该癌症发生于淋巴管和血管内壁。除淋巴结肿大外，阴道区域和口腔部位也是KS的额外靶向区域。称为Sox蛋白的DNA结合蛋白存在于所有哺乳动物中，属于HMG盒超家族。它们调控多种发育过程，如胚层形成、器官生长和细胞类型选择。人类发育异常和先天性疾病常由Sox蛋白的缺失或突变引起。目的：本研究旨在通过计算研究确定有前景的卡波西肉瘤抑制剂。目标：在本研究中，采用计算方法评估针对卡波西肉瘤的抗致癌功效。方法：基于配体的药效团筛选使用四种不同化学库（Asinex、Chembridge、Specs和NCI天然产物（NSC））进行，依据最优假设。顶级命中化合物通过分子对接、吸收、分布、代谢和排泄进行检测。分析最高占据分子轨道和最低未占据分子轨道以确定先导化合物的生物和药理功效。研究结果表明，领先候选物是可能的SOX蛋白抑制剂。结果：在本计算实验中，使用一组19种壳聚糖化合物生成了抑制卡波西肉瘤中SOX蛋白产生的药效团模型。结论：结果显示，顶级命中化合物满足所有药理学类药性标准，并具有最佳相互作用残基、适应度评分和对接评分。所得先导物可能成为卡波西肉瘤的潜在替代治疗方法。
